    const accountBilling = ref("/account/billing");

    const items = ref([]);
    const searchQuery = ref(""), statusFilter = ref("all"), sortBy = ref("newest"), viewMode = ref("folders");
    const selectedProjects = ref([]);
    const visibleProjects = computed(() => items.value.filter((project) => `${project.name} ${project.folder || ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.value.toLowerCase()) && (statusFilter.value === "all" || (statusFilter.value === "has_clips" ? project.clips.length > 0 : project.status === statusFilter.value))).sort((a, b) => sortBy.value === "name" ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : sortBy.value === "oldest" ? a.updatedAt - b.updatedAt : b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt));
    const groups = computed(() => {
      const values = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
      const today = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toLocaleDateString();
      for (const project of visibleProjects.value) {
        const day = new Date(project.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString();
        const label = viewMode.value === "folders" ? project.folder || "Unfiled" : day === today ? "Today" : day;
        values.set(label, [...values.get(label) || [], project]);
      }
      return Array.from(values, ([label, projects2]) => ({ label, projects: projects2 }));
    });
    const media = matchMedia("(max-width: 767px)");
    const compact = ref(media.matches);
    const resize = () => {
      compact.value = media.matches;
    };

    const error = ref("");

    const working = ref(false);
    const creating = ref(false);
    const projectName = ref("");
    const nameInput = ref();
    const state = useWorkspace();
    async function renameProject(project) {
      const name = window.prompt("Project name", project.name);
      if (!name?.trim()) return;
      await run(async () => {
        await workspaceClient.patch(`/web/projects/${project.id}`, { name });
        await load();
      });
    }
    async function moveSelected() {
      const folder = window.prompt("Folder name (leave empty for Unfiled)");
      if (folder === null) return;
      await run(async () => {
        for (const id of selectedProjects.value) await workspaceClient.patch(`/web/projects/${id}`, { folder });
        selectedProjects.value = [];
        await load();
      });
    }
    async function deleteSelected() {
      if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${selectedProjects.value.length} projects and all their clips?`)) return;
      await run(async () => {
        try {
          for (const id of [...selectedProjects.value]) {
            await projects.remove(id);
            selectedProjects.value = selectedProjects.value.filter((value) => value !== id);
          }
        } finally {
          await load();
        }
      });
    }
    watch(() => state.workspace.value?.jobs[0]?.status, (status, previous) => {
      if (embedded && status === "completed" && previous !== "completed")
        window.parent.postMessage({ type: "clippster-account-refresh" }, location.origin);
    });
    watch(creating, async (value) => {
      if (value) {
        await nextTick();
        nameInput.value?.focus();
      }
    });
    watch(sessionExpired, (expired) => {
      if (expired) {
        user.value = null;
        items.value = [];
        state.close();
      }
    });
    async function load() {
      loading.value = true;
      try {
        items.value = (await projects.list()).projects;
      } catch (cause) {
        error.value = errorMessage(cause);
      } finally {
        loading.value = false;
      }
    }
    async function signedIn(value) {
      sessionExpired.value = false;
      user.value = value;
      if (!needsPlanSelection(value)) await load();
      if (embedded && params.get("view") === "download" && !needsPlanSelection(value)) creating.value = true;
    }
    async function logout() {
      await client.post("/auth/logout");
      user.value = null;
      items.value = [];
      state.close();
    }
    async function open(id) {
      error.value = "";
      try {
        await state.open(id);
      } catch (cause) {
        error.value = errorMessage(cause);
      }
    }
    async function close() {
      state.close();
      await load();
    }
    async function create() {
      if (!nameInput.value?.reportValidity()) return;
      working.value = true;
      error.value = "";
      try {
        const result = await projects.create(projectName.value);
        creating.value = false;
        projectName.value = "";
        await load();
        await open(result.project.id);
      } catch (cause) {
        error.value = errorMessage(cause);
      } finally {
        working.value = false;
      }
    }
    async function removeProject(id, name) {
      if (!window.confirm(`Delete “${name}” and all its source files and clips?`)) return;
      working.value = true;
      error.value = "";
      try {
        await projects.remove(id);
        await load();
      } catch (cause) {
        error.value = errorMessage(cause);
      } finally {
        working.value = false;
      }
    }
    async function run(operation) {
      try {
        await operation();
        if (embedded) window.parent.postMessage({ type: "clippster-account-refresh" }, location.origin);
      } catch {
      }
    }
    async function manual(time, end) {
      const project = state.workspace.value?.project;
      if (!project) return;
      const start = Math.min(time, project.duration - 0.1);
      await run(
        () => state.saveClip({
          name: `Clip ${project.clips.length + 1}`,
          aspectRatio: "9:16",
          captions: false,
          segments: [{ start_time: start, end_time: Math.min(end ?? start + 30, project.duration) }]
        })
      );
    }
    async function save(clip, build) {
      await run(async () => {
        await state.saveClip(clip, clip.id, clip.revision);
        if (build) await state.action((id) => projects.build(id, clip.id));
      });
    }
    onMounted(async () => {
      const settings = await client.get("/auth/config").catch(() => null);
      if (settings && !embedded) accountBilling.value = `${settings.accountOrigin}/account/billing`;
      try {
        const result = await auth.me();
        if (result.success && result.user) await signedIn(result.user);
      } catch {
        error.value = "Unable to connect to Clippster.";
      } finally {
        booting.value = false;
      }
    });
    const __returned__ = { AccountTools, BrowserProjectWorkspace, user, params, embedded, toolView, accountBilling, booting, items, searchQuery, statusFilter, sortBy, viewMode, selectedProjects, visibleProjects, groups, media, compact, resize, error, loading, working, creating, projectName, nameInput, state, renameProject, moveSelected, deleteSelected, load, signedIn, logout, open, close, create, removeProject, run, manual, save, get Folder() {
